sample_unit: single-choice questions (each entered 10 times in Chinese and English)

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT answers across ten repeated entries of the same question
links.effect: About 50% of cases showed high consistency; about one-third of cases showed unacceptable blurring of the answers.
links.quote: In approximately 50% of the cases, the responses generated by ChatGPT exhibited a high degree of consistency, whereas in approximately one-third of the cases, the responses exhibited unacceptable blurring of the answers.

links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy on single-choice carbon monoxide poisoning exam questions in Chinese and English
links.effect: Accuracy was 61.1% in Chinese and 57% in English against the question bank reference answers.
links.quote: Meanwhile, the accuracy of these responses was less favorable, with an accuracy rate of 61.1% in Chinese and 57% in English.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT on a set of multiple-choice exam questions about carbon monoxide poisoning without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
